presentation.label: FILTER HZ
presentation.summary: The FILTER page's FRQ popup shows the cutoff in hertz, from 13.8Hz to 21.1kHz, instead of 0 to 127.
presentation.overview: Filter Hz changes what the FRQ value popup on the FILTER page says. Instead of the stock 0 to 127 it shows the cutoff frequency to three significant figures: 13.8Hz at 0, 440Hz at 60, 1.11kHz at 76 and 21.1kHz at 127, one semitone a step. The scale comes from MrScruff's measurement of the self-oscillating filter. Only the display changes: the filter, its range, saved kits and every other parameter are untouched. When FRQ is locked on a trig, the white box behind the value is wider than stock's, 33 pixels, so kHz values fit inside it. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0008-filter-hz, with his code unchanged; Modwerk 1.2.1 adds the wider box.
highlights: The FRQ popup reads in Hz and kHz to three significant figures.
One semitone a step, with 440Hz at the stock value 60.
A locked FRQ's white box is wide enough for kHz values, the same size for every value.
Display only: the filter, its range and saved kits are unchanged.
MrScruff's rytm-mods code, unchanged, linked by the elemod core; Modwerk adds the wider box.
usage: Use a build containing Filter Hz. Select a track and press FILTER to open its FILTER page.
Turn FRQ (knob E). The value popup reads the cutoff in hertz instead of 0 to 127: 440Hz at the stock value 60, one semitone a step.
Turn FRQ fully right for 21.1kHz, the open filter, or fully left for 13.8Hz. RES and every other parameter still show their plain numbers.

access.location: Any track's FILTER page: the FRQ value popup (knob E).
steps: Select a track and press FILTER.
Turn FRQ (knob E); its value popup reads the cutoff in Hz or kHz.

controls.name: Knob E — FRQ
controls.doc: Unchanged control. Its value popup shows the cutoff frequency, 13.8Hz at 0 to 21.1kHz at 127, one semitone a step, instead of the number.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, with core-ar2 0.3. Version 1.2.0 drops the OS 1.73 release (core-ar2 0.1), which Modwerk no longer supports.
The scale was measured on the self-oscillating LP2 filter; the other filter types are assumed to share it.
The popup shows the knob's value: envelope depth, LFO modulation and parameter locks applied elsewhere are not included.
The 0 to 127 number is no longer shown for FRQ.
Two stock sites: param_value_text (0x400a86b4) and the lock box in stock's knob value drawing (0x40037bea). Another module patching either cannot be combined with it.

load.display: None in the audio path: runs only when the FRQ value text or a lock box is drawn
load.conditions: Static: one site is in param_value_text, the routine that formats a parameter's value text for the screen, the other in stock's knob value drawing where a locked value's box is drawn; nothing is added to the audio, sequencer or tick paths. Not a measurement.

hardware.summary: npp1993 reports that on an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74, FZ78 (the released core-ar2 0.3 with Filter Hz 1.2.1 alone, booted from RAM over USB, 2026-11-14) kept FRQ's white lock box the same width and covering the whole value at 440Hz, 1.11kHz, 2.22kHz and 21.1kHz; a locked RES looked as before; unlocked FRQ read 13.8Hz and 21.1kHz at the ends; and about a minute of playback while turning FRQ had no freezes or dropouts.
limitations: Tested by a maintainer, not by the module's author.
Booted from RAM; the flash was not written.
FZ78: .syx 3554efa8d84a384bc18c8f0cf5336d493ca2b26137091432d3ebc610a946a93f. Firmware was not read back from the device.
Playback not timed exactly; other filter types, other pages' locks and other modules beside it not tried.

tests.summary: 1.2.1: in rytm-emu a locked FRQ's box is 33 pixels for every value, one pixel wider than the widest text each side; unlocked FRQ and other parameters' lock boxes are pixel-identical to 1.2.0. On an Analog Rytm MKII (FZ78, RAM boot, 2026-11-14) the box covered every value tried and RES looked as before. 1.2.0: the FRQ popup shows Hz on an Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74, with the released core-ar2 0.3 and Filter Hz alone (FZ74, 2026-10-22).
